meta.promptText: I want to buy a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast on Indian skin. Which one is best?

response.text:
If your priority is **high protection + no obvious white cast on Indian skin**, my first pick would be:

### [Minimalist Light Fluid Face Sunscreen SPF 50]()
*₹315*

### 🥇 Best overall: Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50
- **Very lightweight, fluid texture**
- Designed to blend invisibly rather than sit on the skin
- **SPF 50** with strong UVA protection
- A good choice if you want something that doesn't look like you're wearing sunscreen.
- Current listings I found are around **₹315–₹450**, depending on seller. [www.buyrn.in](https://www.buyrn.in/article/best-sunscreen-india-spf-50?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🥈 If you have oily skin: Re'equil Ultra Matte
### [Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++]()
*₹580.50*

This is particularly good if you hate a **greasy/shiny finish**. User reviews consistently mention no white cast and a matte finish. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/re-equil-ultra-matte-dry-touch-sunscreen-gel-spf-50-na/reviews/2649620?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🥉 If you want a little more hydration: Dot & Key Watermelon
### [Dot & Key Watermelon Cooling Sunscreen]()
*₹263*

A better option if your skin is **normal/dry** and you prefer a slightly dewier finish.

**One important point:** if you're **medium-deep to deep Indian skin**, I'd lean toward a **chemical sunscreen or a properly tinted sunscreen**. Mineral sunscreens containing zinc oxide/titanium dioxide are much more likely to show a cast.

If you tell me your **skin type (oily/dry/combination)** and roughly your **skin tone (fair/medium/wheatish/deep)**, I can narrow it down to **one exact sunscreen** for you.
